def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

    lib += '''
def line_grid_stats(grid):
    """Split the grid into cells bounded by full one-color rows and columns; return (bg, line, dot, cell_counts)."""
    from collections import Counter
    colors = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    line = max(colors, key=lambda c: sum(1 for row in grid if row.count(c) == len(grid[0])) +
             sum(1 for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[j] == c for row in grid)))
    full_rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == line for v in row)}
    full_cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[j] == line for row in grid)}
    bg = max((c for c in colors if c != line), key=lambda c: colors[c])
    dot = next(c for c in colors if c not in (bg, line))
    row_bands, col_bands = [], []
    last = -1
    for i in sorted(full_rows | {len(grid)}):
        if i - last > 1: row_bands.append((last + 1, i))
        last = i
    last = -1
    for j in sorted(full_cols | {len(grid[0])}):
        if j - last > 1: col_bands.append((last + 1, j))
        last = j
    counts = [[sum(1 for i in range(a, b) for j in range(c, d) if grid[i][j] == dot)
               for c, d in col_bands] for a, b in row_bands]
    return bg, line, dot, counts

def mark_multi_dot_cells(grid, mark=1, threshold=2):
    """Cells bounded by full lines: cells holding at least `threshold` dots become `mark`, others the background."""
    bg, line, dot, counts = line_grid_stats(grid)
    return [[mark if n >= threshold else bg for n in row] for row in counts]
